description: Create a draft with a title and one variant per account (publishes nothing). Check with drafts_validate and get user approval before publish or schedule. For TikTok accounts, the owner must set visibility and interaction choices on the screen linked in `choose`: hand over that link and never send TikTok choices here.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tags.description: Up to 10 campaign tags (e.g. "spring-launch") for Results grouping and UTM {tag}; never posted.

title.description: Internal draft name (up to 200 characters); never posted.

variants.description: One entry per target account with its caption, mediaIds and optional network options.

kind.description: Omit for a normal post; "story" sends 1 photo/video to an Instagram or Facebook story with empty text.

mediaIds.description: Ordered media ids from media_upload_link, media_upload, media_list or templates_render; empty for text-only.

options.description: Optional per-network settings (never send for TikTok: owner chooses via choose link). Also accepts Instagram (collaborators, tags, cover, reelsOnly, trial, aiGenerated), X (thread), Threads (quotePostId, replyToId), Mastodon (spoilerText, language), YouTube (videoTags, containsSyntheticMedia, publishAt), Pinterest (cover), and Google Business Profile (language, button, title, start, end, offer); see capabilities.

board.description: Pinterest board name or id (see boards_list); defaults to the account board.

documentTitle.description: LinkedIn PDF title, 1 to 200 characters. Defaults to the filename without its extension.

firstReply.description: First reply/comment under the post: X (280), Threads (500), LinkedIn (1250), Instagram or Facebook Pages (2200).

link.description: Pinterest https destination URL (defaults to first URL in caption).

threadPosts.description: 1 to 24 chained follow-up replies on X, Threads, Bluesky or Mastodon.

type.description: Google Business Profile post type: update (default), offer or event.

visibility.description: YouTube (ask user: public, unlisted or private; defaults to public if unset) or Mastodon visibility.

text.description: Caption within the network limit (see capabilities); empty for a story. On YouTube, line 1 is the title.

name: drafts_create
title: Write a draft
